sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ excerpt provided does not state any pre-payment charge for gold loans.

The in-force UCB directions say that, in cases other than the listed exceptions, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, but the applicability to this gold loan case is not established from the provided facts.
